description: CFG-405: a secret-classified value never appears in log output

expect.note: When the Config — or any field of it carrying the secret — is written to log output (a logging call, a structured-log field, or the value's own logging/format representation), the secret renders as the placeholder and never as the raw value. Log output is one of the MUST-NOT-appear surfaces named in config.md §Secret Redaction, distinct from debug/display (CFG-401), serialization (CFG-402), and error messages (CFG-403).
